description_en: Queries the activation status of the IP address pool feature by calling the GetPublicIpAddressPoolServiceStatus operation
description_zh: 调用GetPublicIpAddressPoolServiceStatus接口查询IP地址池功能的开通状态
name: GetPublicIpAddressPoolServiceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IP address pool.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IP地址池所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

Enabled.description_en:
Indicates whether the IP address pool feature is activated. Valid values:

true: activated.

false: not activated. You can call the OpenPublicIpAddressPoolService operation to activate the IP address pool feature
Enabled.description_zh:
IP地址池功能是否开通。取值：

true：已开通。

false：未开通。您可以调用OpenPublicIpAddressPoolService接口开通IP地址池功能
